name: OSS_USAGE_INVOICE_REQUEST_T
description: Following table is used to capture 'Send Subscription Usage Events Attachment to Receivables' ess job request information.

columns.name: USAGE_INVOICE_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture unique identifier of  usage invoice attach request.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture the subscription id of the ess parameter subscription number.

columns.name: BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture ess parameter business unit id.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture ess parameter customer party id.

columns.name: INVOICE_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture the invoice id of the ess parameter invoice number.

columns.name: INTERFACE_DATE
columns.description: Field used to capture ess parameter interface date.

columns.name: START_TIME
columns.description: Field used to capture time of starting of process.

columns.name: END_TIME
columns.description: Field used to capture time of ending of process.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Field used to capture request job status.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
